title: A Life Group's Calendar: telling the group about one Sunday
question: As you asked (#56), Its Sundays goes: a group with a set shows a linked calendar's events only between its set's first and last Sunday (an all-year group: the sets it doesn't sit out), and its own or added calendars show everything. Unlinking moves into each linked calendar's ⋯ menu and asks once (#50), and leaders can link from the phone (#54). One thing needs a home now: the "No class this Sunday" and "bring a plate" notes that lived on Its Sundays. They're for this group only, so they can't go on the shared Life Groups event. Where should a leader set them? Two more quick questions follow on this page.

options.label: On the Sunday itself, in Coming up
options.thesis: Each of its Sundays in Coming up has a ⋯ menu for leaders: No class this Sunday, Add a note for the group. The change shows on that row, struck through or with the note under it.
options.viewport: Calendar tab: Add a calendar and Link a calendar, Coming up with its Sundays (one struck through: No class this Sunday), the ⋯ menu open, then Linked calendars.
options.risk: Only Sundays in Coming up can be changed (about the next 12 events), so a note for a Sunday months away waits until it comes up.

options.label: A strip of its Sundays above Coming up
options.thesis: A short row of date tiles for the set's Sundays (15, 22, 29 Nov, 6 Dec), marked No class or Note. Tap one to tell the group about it in a sheet; Coming up shows the result.
options.viewport: Calendar tab: the tools, Its Sundays as four date tiles (22 No class, 29 Note), Coming up below; the sheet for Sunday 22 November open.
options.risk: Keeps a second list of Sundays next to Coming up, which is close to the doubling you found counter-intuitive.

options.label: Tell the group in News
options.thesis: A change to a Sunday is a News post for one of its Sundays ("No class on Sunday 22 Nov"), so it notifies the group like any post; Coming up shows it under that Sunday, linked to the post.
options.viewport: Calendar tab: the tools, Tell the group about a Sunday, then Coming up with 22 Nov struck through and "News: No class on Sunday 22 Nov" under it.
options.risk: A post is heavier than a quick note, and the group is notified each time.
